professionalSummary.text: Builds and maintains Java or Kotlin services behind regulated open-banking endpoints, including payment-initiation endpoints.
professionalSummary.witness: Built the Kotlin service behind the account-balances endpoint at Harrowgate Building Society, including pagination, consent checks and mapping of internal errors to the standard's error codes.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains automated conformance tests against the published open-banking standard.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the conformance test suite passing against each new version of the open-banking standard and added test cases for the variable recurring payments consent flow.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Demonstrates a measured response-time improvement on an API path against a recorded baseline.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: The gateway performance report cited by the candidate was requested directly from Harrowgate Building Society's API platform office. It records a p95 response time of 1,180 ms on the transactions-history endpoint for 1 to 28 February 2024 and 410 ms for 1 to 28 April 2024, and names the candidate as author of the change released on 15 March 2024.

skills.text: Works with the security team on mutual-TLS certificate rotation for third-party connections.
skills.witness: Joined the quarterly certificate rotation with the security team, updating the trust-store configuration for third-party provider connections and checking the handshake logs afterwards.

evidence.text: Built the Kotlin service behind the account-balances endpoint at Harrowgate Building Society, including pagination, consent checks and mapping of internal errors to the standard's error codes.
Kept the conformance test suite passing against each new version of the open-banking standard and added test cases for the variable recurring payments consent flow.

The gateway performance report cited by the candidate was requested directly from Harrowgate Building Society's API platform office. It records a p95 response time of 1,180 ms on the transactions-history endpoint for 1 to 28 February 2024 and 410 ms for 1 to 28 April 2024, and names the candidate as author of the change released on 15 March 2024.
Joined the quarterly certificate rotation with the security team, updating the trust-store configuration for third-party provider connections and checking the handshake logs afterwards.

The candidate's Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 17 Developer credential was looked up on the vendor's certification verification page with the validation number the candidate supplied; it is listed as earned in May 2023.
